description: Complaints that free listening is constrained by ads and limits on choosing, skipping, or playing songs in a preferred order, making the app frustrating to use.
name: Listening controls and free-tier restrictions

description: Reports of the app showing a black screen, shutting down during playback, or falsely reporting no internet connection while playing music.
name: Playback and app stability

description: Complaints about premium requirements, subscription access problems, and features or listening options being moved behind a paid plan.
name: Premium access and subscription concerns

description: General negative reactions to the app or an update without a specific problem described.
name: General dissatisfaction

description: Complaints about unavailable songs, limited previews, or trouble accessing Spotify Wrapped.
name: Music catalog and content availability

description: Reports of being unable to log in or access an account, including errors that persist despite working internet access elsewhere.
name: Account login and access problems

description: Problems with offline listening, downloads, storage changes, lost playlists, and related app integrations or settings.
name: Offline listening and saved music

description: Negative feedback about Spotify customer support or its perceived stance on social issues.
name: Support and company stance
